## Overcap 0.1.2

Live quotas, reset times and spend across your coding tools from one desktop app.

### What's fixed

- Rebuilt the Overcap mark as a clear closed O with its orange cap seated on the ring
- Synchronized the corrected mark across the app, tray, installers, website, favicon and social artwork
- Removed outdated demo screenshots from the repository README
- Added a brand-asset contract so future logo drift fails CI

### Product highlights

- A hero gauge that surfaces your tightest current limit
- Pace and monthly-spend projections
- Seven-day provider sparklines
- Configurable 80%, 95%, and 100% threshold alerts
- Shareable usage receipts and provider nicknames
- Local credential storage with no analytics or telemetry

### Downloads

- Windows x64 and ARM64: NSIS installer
- macOS: Universal DMG for Apple silicon and Intel
- Linux x64 and ARM64: AppImage and Debian package

This public beta is not yet Authenticode-signed or Apple-notarised, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper may ask you to confirm the install. See the [install guide](https://github.com/AJ-Base44/overcap/blob/main/docs/install.md) for the exact safe steps.

Automatic update packages are separately protected by Overcap's bundled updater signature. Linux in-app updates are supported by AppImage builds; Debian packages update through your package installer.
